name: dv0x
description: DV0x for Claude: Brand Reels (explainer reels for brands, made entirely in code) and Brand Ads (research-driven hooks for still-image Meta ads).

plugins.name: brand-reels
plugins.description: Brand Reels: 30-to-35-second explainer reels for a brand's product, made entirely in code from the brand's website, in its own colours, fonts and logo, with voice, captions, music and sound. No image or video generation.

plugins.name: brand-ads
plugins.description: Brand Ads: research-driven hooks for still-image Meta ads for skincare and supplement products, from a product link, each with its evidence: the product's reviews, rivals' live ads and what buyers say. Pictures come in a later version.
